title: Organic Cotton!
text: Organic Cotton!. These little dish cloths are the size of a wash cloth. They are not full sized towels. They are fairly thin and don't have much texture to them. I prefer a little more texture in order to get stuck on food off of my dishes. The color assortment is nice and I love that they are made from organic cotton.

product_metadata.title: Full Circle Kind Collection 100% Organic Cotton Plant-Dyed Dish Cloths, Set of 3, Pomegranate
features: Organic cotton naturally dyed with pomegranate
description: The enclosed organic beauties are dyed with curated, clean plant pigments - ensuring both health and style in your home. The baby blanket-like weave dries quickly to prevent odors for a cloth thats kind on your hands, and the planet.
